name: element.list
description: Enumerate interactable / named UI Automation elements. Optionally restrict to a screen sub-rectangle.

region.description: Restrict enumeration to elements whose bounding rectangle intersects this region. Omit to enumerate the entire desktop.

name.description: UIA Name property. May be empty for elements without a name.

automation_id.description: UIA AutomationId. Empty string when the element doesn't expose one.

flags.description: Universally-determinable UIA boolean states currently true on the element. Per issue #92.

x-implementations.name: uia_walk
x-implementations.description: UI Automation `IUIAutomation::CreateTreeWalker` with a content-view condition; walks visible elements rooted at the desktop. Region filter applied via `IUIAutomationElement::CurrentBoundingRectangle` intersection. Allocates a fresh `elt:N` id per element via the connection-scoped allocator.

windows-modern.description: UIA tree walk via the content-view filter. UIPI / integrity barriers can hide elements from the walk — returns `ERR uia_blind` when the agent's IL is below the target's. Element ids are allocated per-connection and remain valid until the connection closes (or the underlying element is invalidated, surfaced as `ERR target_gone` on subsequent verbs).

windows-classic.reason: Requires UI Automation (Vista+). Classic Windows (NT 4 / 2000 / XP) has only MSAA / IAccessible, which doesn't map cleanly to the UIA-based element model in this spec. Future enhancement could add a separate MSAA-backed verb if there's demand.
